info.title: CF Meet Messaging internal API
info.description: Service-authenticated /internal/v1 surface of services/messaging (Part V H §§97–112, I §116). Every path, including unknown ones, requires a valid Ed25519 service token whose issuer Messaging's trust bundle grants the operation's permission; customer credentials are refused. Scope comes only from the signed delegated platform context, re-validated against Platform Access (forged chains: DELEGATED_CONTEXT_INVALID; suspended: AUTHORITY_SUSPENDED). In addition, /internal/v1/delegated/v1/messaging/** and /internal/v1/delegated/v1/conversations/** expose exactly the customer operations of cfmeet.messaging.http-api to a FIRST_PARTY backend granted messaging-application.delegate, with the standard scopes messages.send, messages.read, conversations.create, conversations.manage, attachments.write and attachments.read (never moderation, export or administration); CF-Acting-Principal is verified as on /v1. 1.1.0 (gap audit G6 / G7): organization moderation under /internal/v1/organization-moderation/v1/messaging/** and team channels (PUT /internal/v1/team-channels), permission messaging-organization.govern. 1.2.0 (ADR 0062 §8, partner meeting chat): the meeting-conversation operations also accept a Meeting Service holding messaging-meeting.sync-platform for an ACTIVE EXTERNAL environment's signed delegated scope (re-validated against Platform Access) while MESSAGING_PARTNER_SESSION_DEVICES_ENABLED is on; such a conversation is MANAGED only (SECURITY_PROFILE_NOT_ALLOWED / PARTNER_MEETING_CHAT_MANAGED_ONLY otherwise). First-party scopes keep requiring messaging-meeting.sync (sync-platform alone is INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED there). In a partner scope the owner must be the environment's meeting system principal (BOT_OR_SERVICE; PRINCIPAL_NOT_AUTHORIZED / PARTNER_MEETING_OWNER_KIND) and admitted members EXTERNAL_APPLICATION_PRINCIPAL or TEMPORARY_EXTERNAL_PARTICIPANT principals of that environment (PARTNER_MEETING_MEMBER_KIND; another environment's principal is PRINCIPAL_UNKNOWN). 1.3.0 (ADR 0068, admin bridge): operator attribution (X-CF-Operator, X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref, X-CF-Intent-Digest) accepted only from cfmeet.admin-bridge and refused on every internal route from any other caller (403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED); the admin bridge's operator reads GET /internal/v1/operator/reports, /reports/{reportId}, /holds, /exports, /deletion-requests, /audit, /switches, /incidents, /failed-messages and /key-transparency (messaging-firstparty.administer, cfmeet.admin-bridge only, plus X-CF-Operator): ids, categories, states, counts and times only, never content, ciphertext, keys, report evidence, audit detail, payloads, export object keys or case references. 1.4.0 (ADR 0068 A4 / A5 / A7, admin bridge commands): POST /internal/v1/operator/reports/{reportId}/remove-message, /reports/{reportId}/dismiss, /conversations/{conversationId}/members/{principalId}/mute and /remove, /conversations/{conversationId}/restrict, /policy, /holds, /holds/{holdId}/release, /deletion-requests, /switches/{switchName}, /incidents/{incidentId}/resolve, /failed-messages/{eventId}/retry and /key-transparency/checkpoint (Idempotency-Key; expectedVersion where the resource is versioned; X-CF-Approver for R3 / R4; answer {status, version, resource}); the settlement read GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey} (messaging_admin_operations, written in the change's transaction); GET /internal/v1/operator/policy, /conversations/{conversationId} and /conversations/{conversationId}/members/{principalId}; reports and holds carry their row version. 1.5.0 (ADR 0068 final round, owner-delivered exports): POST /internal/v1/operator/exports (messaging.export.request, R4) registers an export of a MANAGED conversation delivered ONLY to the verified recipient it names (never the tenant), answered with a reference (delivery OWNER_DELIVERED, deliveryChannel CONSOLE_REVEAL_ONCE, deliveryRef, exportState); GET /internal/v1/operator/exports/{exportId} reads its state; the A2 export list carries each export's delivery; the recipient lists and claims it once on the delegated mirror (GET /internal/v1/delegated/v1/messaging/export-deliveries, POST /internal/v1/delegated/v1/messaging/exports/{exportId}/claim). 1.6.0 (ADR 0068 A7, daily datasets): GET /internal/v1/operator/datasets/{datasetId}/days/{day} answers cfmeet.messaging_daily (messages_sent) and cfmeet.operations_health (failed_messages) for a UTC day: counts only, null when not computable.

Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) plus X-CF-Operator; commands also take an Idempotency-Key and, when two-person, the approval headers.

tags.name: Internal — Owner-Delivered Exports
tags.description: The recipient's side of owner-delivered exports (ADR 0068): listed and claimed once in the recipient's own CF Meet console, relayed by a first-party backend on the delegated mirror. References and one download grant only.

post.description: Idempotently resolves the MEETING conversation of a meeting reference (context namespace meeting). Never a silent profile fallback. Permission messaging-meeting.sync; signed delegated scope of a FIRST_PARTY environment, re-validated against Platform Access. 1.2.0: or messaging-meeting.sync-platform for an EXTERNAL environment (partner meeting chat, MANAGED only; MESSAGING_PARTNER_SESSION_DEVICES_ENABLED).

put.description: Applies a version-fenced meeting membership change (admission, removal, ban, leave, role). Stale / replayed versions change nothing. Permission messaging-meeting.sync; signed delegated scope of a FIRST_PARTY environment, re-validated against Platform Access. 1.2.0: or messaging-meeting.sync-platform for an EXTERNAL environment (partner meeting chat, MANAGED only; MESSAGING_PARTNER_SESSION_DEVICES_ENABLED).

post.description: Applies a version-fenced meeting lifecycle change (e.g. CLOSED when the meeting ends). Permission messaging-meeting.sync; signed delegated scope of a FIRST_PARTY environment, re-validated against Platform Access. 1.2.0: or messaging-meeting.sync-platform for an EXTERNAL environment (partner meeting chat, MANAGED only; MESSAGING_PARTNER_SESSION_DEVICES_ENABLED).

Imports legacy meeting chat with LEGACY_MANAGED provenance into a MANAGED meeting conversation (never PRIVATE_E2EE), idempotently, keeping original times. Permission messaging-meeting.sync; signed delegated scope of a FIRST_PARTY environment, re-validated against Platform Access. 1.2.0: or messaging-meeting.sync-platform for an EXTERNAL environment (partner meeting chat, MANAGED only; MESSAGING_PARTNER_SESSION_DEVICES_ENABLED).

Removes (tombstones as MODERATED) a message of a meeting conversation on behalf of the meeting authority. Permission messaging-meeting.sync; signed delegated scope of a FIRST_PARTY environment, re-validated against Platform Access. The content is never returned. 1.2.0: or messaging-meeting.sync-platform for an EXTERNAL environment (partner meeting chat, MANAGED only; MESSAGING_PARTNER_SESSION_DEVICES_ENABLED).

Applies Privacy Relay's authority for one of its communication contexts to every conversation of that context in the signed delegated environment: SUSPENDED locks, REVOKED closes (and blocks reopening / new conversations), ACTIVE allows creation and unlocks what the authority locked. Permission messaging-context-authority.apply (Privacy Relay only).

Permission messaging-sms-bridge.deliver (SMS Gateway only), signed delegated scope re-validated against Platform Access. An inbound SMS of a bridged party becomes a MANAGED message with channel SMS (idempotent per SMS id); never injected into an E2EE conversation.

get.description: G6: the organization's moderation queue (no evidence in the listing). The SAME moderation handler as the customer route GET /v1/messaging/reports: the signed initiating principal is the organization moderator (required, ACTIVE in the scope; a CF-Acting-Principal header is refused with ADMINISTRATION_ONLY); the Meeting Service relays only for a member whose organization grants messaging.organization.moderate. The scope is the organization's own environment, so only its conversations are visible. Permission messaging-organization.govern (Meeting Service only); signed delegated scope of a FIRST_PARTY organization environment, re-validated against Platform Access.

G6: one report with its evidence; the view is audited with the moderator's principal. The SAME moderation handler as the customer route GET /v1/messaging/reports/{reportId}: the signed initiating principal is the organization moderator (required, ACTIVE in the scope; a CF-Acting-Principal header is refused with ADMINISTRATION_ONLY); the Meeting Service relays only for a member whose organization grants messaging.organization.moderate. The scope is the organization's own environment, so only its conversations are visible. Permission messaging-organization.govern (Meeting Service only); signed delegated scope of a FIRST_PARTY organization environment, re-validated against Platform Access.

G6: the organization's moderation actions, newest first. The SAME moderation handler as the customer route GET /v1/messaging/moderation/actions: the signed initiating principal is the organization moderator (required, ACTIVE in the scope; a CF-Acting-Principal header is refused with ADMINISTRATION_ONLY); the Meeting Service relays only for a member whose organization grants messaging.organization.moderate. The scope is the organization's own environment, so only its conversations are visible. Permission messaging-organization.govern (Meeting Service only); signed delegated scope of a FIRST_PARTY organization environment, re-validated against Platform Access.

post.description: G6: remove a message, mute / unmute or remove a member, restrict / un-restrict a principal or dismiss a report; recorded append-only with moderatorPrincipalId and audited. The SAME moderation handler as the customer route POST /v1/messaging/moderation/actions: the signed initiating principal is the organization moderator (required, ACTIVE in the scope; a CF-Acting-Principal header is refused with ADMINISTRATION_ONLY); the Meeting Service relays only for a member whose organization grants messaging.organization.moderate. The scope is the organization's own environment, so only its conversations are visible. Permission messaging-organization.govern (Meeting Service only); signed delegated scope of a FIRST_PARTY organization environment, re-validated against Platform Access.

put.description: G7: creates (201) or resynchronizes (200) the MANAGED GROUP channel of an organization team from a snapshot of its ACTIVE members, version-fenced (a stale snapshot answers applied false / STALE_VERSION). Listed principals join with authoritySource ORGANIZATION_TEAM; team-sourced members no longer listed are removed (TEAM_MEMBERSHIP_ENDED); the owner and members added any other way are kept. Bans, the lifecycle and the member limit apply (refused principals are reported as skipped). Customers cannot create a conversation in the reserved context namespace organization-team of a first-party environment. Permission messaging-organization.govern (Meeting Service only); signed delegated scope of a FIRST_PARTY organization environment, re-validated against Platform Access.

get.description: Reports, newest first, optionally by status; keyset-paged. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

parameters.name: cursor

get.description: One report and its moderation actions; 404 NOT_FOUND when absent. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.
Legal holds by status (ACTIVE by default), newest first. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

post.description: messaging.hold.place (R3): places a hold (id = the Idempotency-Key) under the environment's exclusive hold lock; it preserves what is stored and never creates a way to decrypt. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. Two-person (R3/R4): X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest are required.

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

get.description: MANAGED conversation exports, newest first. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

post.description: messaging.export.request (R4): an OWNER-DELIVERED export of a MANAGED conversation for the verified requester named in the body (the data subject). Built by the existing export worker (MANAGED only: a PRIVATE_E2EE conversation is 409 E2EE_EXPORT_NOT_AVAILABLE; the conversation context's policy must allow exports), stored only when the store confirms encryption at rest (otherwise FAILED STORAGE_NOT_ENCRYPTED), kept 7 days after it is ready and then deleted. Delivered ONLY to the recipient: signed in to their own CF Meet console, relayed by a first-party backend, they claim it once (POST /internal/v1/delegated/v1/messaging/exports/{exportId}/claim); a second claim is refused and nothing is ever re-sent (re-issue the command). The tenant's routes never see it and no tenant event is published for it. Legal holds never block it (it reads, never deletes). The recipient must be an ACTIVE member and a CF Meet account (409 RECIPIENT_NOT_A_MEMBER / RECIPIENT_NOT_VERIFIED). The answer is a reference only. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key (id of the export). The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. Two-person (R3/R4): X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest are required.

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

get.description: Principal erasure and conversation purge requests, newest first. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

post.description: messaging.deletion-request.create (R4): registers a PRINCIPAL_ERASURE or CONVERSATION_PURGE request (id = the Idempotency-Key, PENDING). The existing deletion worker executes it later; legal holds win (held items are preserved, the request ends PARTIALLY_HELD). Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. Two-person (R3/R4): X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest are required.

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

get.description: Tenant audit entries in an optional window, newest first. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Window end (exclusive); at most 31 days after since.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

get.description: Every emergency off-switch row; nextCursor is always null. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

Operational incidents by last occurrence in an optional window, newest first. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Window end (exclusive); at most 31 days after since.

get.description: The tree head (null before the first leaf) and each witness state. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

post.description: messaging.message.remove (R3): tombstones one of an OPEN report's messages by id (MODERATED; never reads or returns its content) and resolves the report ACTIONED, at the report's version. 409 VERSION_CONFLICT / CONFLICT REPORT_NOT_OPEN; 409 CONFLICT KILL_SWITCH_ENGAGED or MODERATION_DISABLED. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. Two-person (R3/R4): X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest are required.

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

post.description: messaging.report.dismiss (R3): resolves an OPEN report DISMISSED at its version (the reason code is its resolution). Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. Two-person (R3/R4): X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest are required.

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

post.description: messaging.member.mute (R3): an ACTIVE member may not send for durationSeconds, at the member's version (409 CONFLICT MEMBER_NOT_ACTIVE). Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. Two-person (R3/R4): X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest are required.

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

post.description: messaging.member.remove (R3): removes an ACTIVE member at the member's version; never the owner (409 OWNER_CANNOT_BE_REMOVED) nor from a DIRECT conversation (409 INVALID_TRANSITION DIRECT_MEMBERSHIP_FIXED). In PRIVATE_E2EE the cryptographic removal follows by a member's MLS commit. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. Two-person (R3/R4): X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest are required.

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

post.description: messaging.conversation.restrict (R3): locks an ACTIVE conversation (LOCKED: no new messages) at its version (409 INVALID_TRANSITION CONVERSATION_NOT_ACTIVE). Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. Two-person (R3/R4): X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest are required.

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

post.summary: Change an environment's chat policy (admin bridge)
post.description: messaging.policy.change (R3): replaces the environment's override document at expectedVersion through the application's own policy path (validation 400, 409 POLICY_VERSION_CONFLICT). A change of any context's allowedProfiles, defaultProfile or centralArchiveRequired is refused (422 SECURITY_PROFILE_NOT_ALLOWED / SECURITY_POSTURE_OWNER_ONLY): the security posture stays the application's decision. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. Two-person (R3/R4): X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest are required.

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

get.summary: Get an environment's chat policy (admin bridge)
get.description: messaging.policy.read (R1): the environment's override document, version, baseline and effective policy; 404 for an environment Messaging does not know for the tenant. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

post.description: messaging.hold.release (R3): releases an ACTIVE hold at its version (409 CONFLICT HOLD_NOT_ACTIVE); deletions it held are re-evaluated. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. Two-person (R3/R4): X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest are required.

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

post.summary: Engage or release an off-switch (admin bridge)
post.description: messaging.switch.change (R3): engages (stops a capability) or releases a switch, globally or for one environment, at the switch row's version (0: never set). 409 CONFLICT SWITCH_ALREADY_IN_STATE; a switch the key-transparency monitor engaged (KT_CHECKPOINT_UNVERIFIABLE) is released only with messaging-admin (409 CONFLICT KT_INTEGRITY_CLI_ONLY). Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. Two-person (R3/R4): X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest are required.

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

post.description: messaging.incident.record (R2): records the resolution of an OPEN incident (409 CONFLICT INCIDENT_NOT_OPEN). A KT_ROLLBACK_DETECTED incident is resolved only with messaging-admin (409 CONFLICT KT_INTEGRITY_CLI_ONLY). Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. No second person (R2).

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

post.description: messaging.failed-message.retry (R2): re-queues one dead-lettered outbox event with a fresh retry budget (409 CONFLICT NOT_DEAD_LETTERED); publication stays idempotent by event id. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. No second person (R2).

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

post.description: messaging.key-transparency.checkpoint (R3): one key-transparency monitor pass now (verify the database log against the operator checkpoint file; advance the file only when consistent). 409 CONFLICT KT_CHECKPOINT_NOT_CONFIGURED without a configured checkpoint file. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED. Requires Idempotency-Key. The change and its operations-ledger record commit in one transaction (settlement: GET /internal/v1/operator/operations/{idempotencyKey}). Refusals are definite 4xx and change nothing. Two-person (R3/R4): X-CF-Approver, X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest are required.

200.description: Applied (or the answer of the first call with this key).

get.summary: Get a command's settlement record (admin bridge)
get.description: The record of an applied command (outcome APPLIED, the status and version it answered). 404 NOT_FOUND for an unknown key and for any caller other than cfmeet.admin-bridge with X-CF-Operator.

A conversation's ids, class, profile, lifecycle and version (what restrict names). Never a title, avatar, member list or content. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

A member's role, state, send restriction and version (what mute / remove name). Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

The reference and state of an owner-delivered export (REQUESTED, READY, DELIVERED, EXPIRED, FAILED), its size and digest. 404 for a tenant's own export and for an unknown id. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator; otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

get.summary: List the acting recipient's owner-delivered exports
get.description: The acting principal's owner-delivered exports, newest first (at most 20), as references. Served ONLY on the delegated mirror (never on /v1): permission messaging-application.delegate, signed delegated scope of a FIRST_PARTY environment re-validated against Platform Access, the signed-in recipient as the (signed) acting principal; scope messages.read. Anyone but the export's recipient gets 404.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: May only repeat the signed initiating principal.

post.description: The single claim of a READY owner-delivered export by its recipient: one short-lived forced-download grant, and the export becomes DELIVERED in the same transaction (audited). 409 EXPORT_NOT_READY, EXPORT_ALREADY_DELIVERED (nothing is re-sent: HQ re-issues the command) or EXPORT_EXPIRED. Served ONLY on the delegated mirror (never on /v1): permission messaging-application.delegate, signed delegated scope of a FIRST_PARTY environment re-validated against Platform Access, the signed-in recipient as the (signed) acting principal; scope messages.read. Anyone but the export's recipient gets 404.

parameters.name: CF-Acting-Principal
parameters.description: May only repeat the signed initiating principal.

get.summary: Get a dataset's daily counts (admin bridge)
get.description: The admin bridge's daily pull (ADR 0068 A7): cfmeet.messaging_daily (messages_sent) and cfmeet.operations_health (failed_messages; Messaging's part only). Counts only, from data Messaging keeps. 404 for any other dataset; 400 for a malformed day or one in the future. Permission messaging-firstparty.administer (cfmeet.admin-bridge only) and X-CF-Operator (the bridge sends hq:dataset-sync); otherwise 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED.

serviceToken.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
serviceToken.description: Ed25519 compact JWS (typ cf-service+jwt) from packages/service-auth, audience cfmeet.messaging.

url.description: A short-lived signed read with a forced download (application/json attachment).

ExportClaimGrant.description: The single download of an owner-delivered export, answered once to its recipient.

recipientMasked.description: Always null: the export is delivered in the recipient's own CF Meet console and Messaging never holds an address.

ExportDelivery.description: The reference of an owner-delivered export (ADR 0068, brief §1): ids, state, size, digest, delivery and times. Never the export, its object key, a URL, a token or an address.

OperatorAuditEntry.description: One tenant audit entry. The detail object is not included.

OperatorConversation.description: A conversation's ids, class, profile, lifecycle and version. Never a title, avatar, member list or content.

messages_sent.description: cfmeet.messaging_daily: accepted application messages of the UTC day, every environment (usage facts; never content).

failed_messages.description: cfmeet.operations_health: committed events of the UTC day that are dead letters now.

OperatorDatasetDay.description: Counts for one UTC day. A metric is null, never a guessed 0, when the day has not ended or its source did not exist for the whole day.

tenantId.description: The tenant (Platform Access tenant id) the resource must belong to; another tenant's resource is 404 NOT_FOUND.

OperatorDeletionRequestRequest.description: PRINCIPAL_ERASURE needs principalId; CONVERSATION_PURGE needs conversationId (in environmentId).

version.description: The resource has no row version.

OperatorDeletionRequestResult.description: The request (id = the Idempotency-Key) is registered PENDING; the deletion worker executes it later and legal holds win.

version.description: The resulting row version (a string of the integer).

OperatorDismissReportResult.description: The report is DISMISSED; version is the report's.

OperatorExport.description: One MANAGED conversation export: the tenant's own (delivery TENANT) or an owner-delivered one (OWNER_DELIVERED). The object key and digest are not included.

tenantId.description: The tenant (Platform Access tenant id) the conversation must belong to; another tenant's conversation is 404 NOT_FOUND.

recipientPrincipalId.description: The verified requester (the data subject): an ACTIVE member of the conversation who is a CF Meet account (NATIVE_CF_USER with a cfmeet-user reference). The export is delivered to this principal only.

version.description: The resource has no row version.

OperatorExportResult.description: The export (id = the Idempotency-Key) is registered; the existing export worker builds it and the recipient claims it in their own CF Meet console.

OperatorFailedMessage.description: One outbox event in DEAD_LETTER. Its payload and error string are not included.

version.description: The resource has no row version.

OperatorFailedMessageRetryResult.description: The dead-lettered outbox event is re-queued with a fresh retry budget (payload never returned).

OperatorHold.description: One legal hold. The case reference is not included.

OperatorIncident.description: One operational incident. Its summary text is not included.

version.description: The resource has no row version.

OperatorKeyTransparency.description: The key-transparency tree head and each witness state. No key material.

version.description: The resource has no row version.

OperatorKtCheckpointResult.description: One key-transparency monitor pass: the checkpoint file advanced (consistent), a rollback / fork incident raised, or the protective switches engaged (unverifiable).

OperatorMember.description: A member's role, state, send restriction and version.

tenantId.description: The tenant (Platform Access tenant id) the resource must belong to; another tenant's resource is 404 NOT_FOUND.

version.description: The resulting row version (a string of the integer).

OperatorMuteMemberResult.description: The member may not send until sendRestrictedUntil; version is the member's.

OperatorOperationRecord.description: The settlement record of an applied command: the same status and version the command answered.

recipientMasked.description: Always null: the export is delivered in the recipient's own CF Meet console and Messaging never holds an address.

OperatorOwnerDeliveredExport.description: An owner-delivered export as HQ sees it (references only). exportState: REQUESTED (being built), READY (the recipient may claim it once), DELIVERED (claimed), EXPIRED (7 days after it was ready; the copy is deleted), FAILED.

tenantId.description: The tenant (Platform Access tenant id) the resource must belong to; another tenant's resource is 404 NOT_FOUND.

caseReference.description: Stored for the record, never returned.

OperatorPlaceHoldRequest.description: CONVERSATION needs conversationId (in environmentId), PRINCIPAL needs principalId, ENVIRONMENT neither.

version.description: The resulting row version (a string of the integer).

OperatorPlaceHoldResult.description: The hold (id = the Idempotency-Key) is ACTIVE at version 1. The case reference is never returned.

version.description: The override document's version (0: none stored).

OperatorPolicy.description: An environment's chat policy: its override document, version, baseline and effective policy (flags, limits, enums; no personal data).

tenantId.description: The tenant (Platform Access tenant id) the resource must belong to; another tenant's resource is 404 NOT_FOUND.

expectedVersion.description: The policy's version (0 when none is stored); 409 POLICY_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise.

version.description: The resulting row version (a string of the integer).

OperatorPolicyChangeResult.description: The override document is replaced; version is the policy's.

version.description: The resulting row version (a string of the integer).

OperatorReleaseHoldResult.description: The hold is RELEASED; version is the hold's.

version.description: The resulting row version (a string of the integer).

OperatorRemoveMemberResult.description: The member is REMOVED; version is the member's.

tenantId.description: The tenant (Platform Access tenant id) the resource must belong to; another tenant's resource is 404 NOT_FOUND.

version.description: The resulting row version (a string of the integer).

OperatorRemoveMessageResult.description: The message is tombstoned (MODERATED) by id and the report ACTIONED; version is the report's.

OperatorReport.description: One report: ids, category, states and times. The evidence (a sealed reporter disclosure or a MANAGED message reference) is never included; evidenceKind only says which kind was given.

OperatorReportDetail.description: One report and its moderation actions (no evidence).

version.description: The resulting row version (a string of the integer).

OperatorRestrictConversationResult.description: The conversation is LOCKED (no new messages); version is the conversation's.

OperatorSwitch.description: One emergency off-switch row (global or per environment).

expectedVersion.description: The switch row's version; 0 when it was never set (absent from the switch list).

version.description: The resulting row version (a string of the integer).

OperatorSwitchChangeResult.description: The switch changed; version is the switch row's.

tenantId.description: The tenant (Platform Access tenant id) the resource must belong to; another tenant's resource is 404 NOT_FOUND.

expectedVersion.description: The resource row's version; the change happens only at that version (409 VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise).

centralArchiveRequired.description: Only MANAGED is allowed (allowedProfiles must be [MANAGED]); an E2EE conversation can never be archived by the server.

exportsEnabled.description: Requires MANAGED; the server never exports E2EE plaintext.

smsBridgeEligible.description: Requires MANAGED among allowedProfiles; SMS is never end-to-end encrypted.

requestsRequireAcceptance.description: Appendix K (DIRECT only): a new direct conversation is a message request â€” the counterpart is INVITED (no delivery, events or key packages) until it accepts (POST .../invitation/accept), then sees the conversation from the start. While pending, PRIVATE_E2EE requests carry no messages (REQUEST_PENDING); after a decline nothing more is delivered (DELIVERY_REFUSED / REQUEST_DECLINED).

forwarding.description: S11: server-side forwarding of MANAGED messages (default true).

forwardShowsOriginalSender.description: S11: forwarded copies show their original sender (default false).

messaging.common.v1.ApplicationPolicy.description: An application environment's overrides of the platform defaults. MANAGED is available for a context only when listed here.

messaging.common.v1.ContextAuthorityUpda.description: Part V H Â§103: the current authority of a peer-owned communication context (opaque reference only; never a telephone number or contact value). Version-fenced; REVOKED / SUSPENDED apply even to a suspended tenant, ACTIVE needs full authority.

messaging.common.v1.ContextClass.description: Generic context classes; a product's order, trip, consultation or case is only an opaque ContextRef.

messaging.common.v1.ContextRef.description: An opaque reference in the application's own namespace. Never authority, never a membership grant.

members.description: The first 100 ACTIVE members (owner, administrators, then members); page through GET /v1/conversations/{id}/members for the rest (membersTruncated).

readReceipts.description: Appendix K: false â€” no read receipts in this conversation; null â€” the environment policy decides.

title.description: Section 13: display title of a MANAGED conversation (always null for PRIVATE_E2EE, whose name belongs inside the MLS group).

avatarRef.description: Section 13: opaque avatar reference of a MANAGED conversation (for example an attachment id the client resolves); never a URL the server fetches.

announcementOnly.description: S13: only OWNER / ADMIN members may send (send, edit and forward); others read and react as policy allows.

messaging.common.v1.Conversation.description: The canonical Conversation aggregate. PRIVATE_E2EE: MLS 1.0 with the server-assigned 32-byte MLS group id; serverCanReadContent is false. MANAGED: no MLS binding; serverCanReadContent is true.

messaging.common.v1.ConversationInbox.description: Section 13 (MSG-007): the inbox summary of a conversation for the acting member, present in GET /v1/conversations answers that have an acting principal. Left conversations are not listed (only ACTIVE memberships are); a tombstoned last message carries its lifecycle and no content.

lastActivityAt.description: The latest application message (or the creation time); the key of orderBy=lastActivity.

unreadCount.description: Active application messages from others after the member's read cursor, inside its history window, not hidden for it.

mentionCount.description: Unread messages that mention the member (the sender's declared mention ids: MANAGED and â€” B3, 1.34.0 â€” PRIVATE_E2EE, whose mention text stays inside the ciphertext).

archived.description: F1 (1.34.0): the member archived this chat for itself (PUT /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/inbox-settings). It stays archived when new messages arrive. Never visible to other members.

pinned.description: F1 (1.34.0): the member pinned this chat for itself (at most three; clients list pinned chats first, most recently pinned first).

pinnedAt.description: F1 (1.34.0): when the member pinned this chat (the pin order); null when not pinned.

messaging.common.v1.ConversationLastMess.description: Preview metadata of the last application message visible to the member (its history window and delete-for-me markers honoured).

previewText.description: MANAGED and ACTIVE only: the first 140 characters of the text. Always null for PRIVATE_E2EE (the server holds no plaintext and never returns ciphertext here) and for tombstones.

smsBridgeEligible.description: A MANAGED conversation of this context may be bridged to SMS (default: whenever MANAGED is allowed; never for an E2EE-only context).

requestsRequireAcceptance.description: Appendix K (DIRECT only): a new direct conversation is a message request â€” the counterpart is INVITED (no delivery, events or key packages) until it accepts (POST .../invitation/accept), then sees the conversation from the start. While pending, PRIVATE_E2EE requests carry no messages (REQUEST_PENDING); after a decline nothing more is delivered (DELIVERY_REFUSED / REQUEST_DECLINED).

messages.description: Message features (platform policy version 4). Replies are always supported; a tenant may turn threads off (replies are kept without a thread root), reactions or pins.

forwarding.description: S11: server-side forwarding of MANAGED messages (default true).

forwardShowsOriginalSender.description: S11: forwarded copies show their original sender (default false).

deliveryReceipts.description: Other members learn when a message was DELIVERED to a recipient (messaging.delivery-cursor.updated / delivery-cursor.updated events).

revisionHistoryVisible.description: Members may read the kept revisions of edited MANAGED messages. Revisions are always kept (exports and legal holds include them).

messaging.common.v1.EffectivePolicy.description: Platform defaults merged with the application's overrides (deterministic; stored as an immutable content-addressed snapshot). Platform policy version 3 (Parts E-G): attachments (off by default), editing windows, privacy of presence / typing / read receipts, retention, moderation, abuse limits; regulated context controls.

messaging.common.v1.Error.description: Error envelope. Messages never contain key material, ciphertext, content, a credential or database text.

messaging.common.v1.InboundSms.description: An inbound SMS of a bridged party (SMS Gateway â†’ Messaging, messaging-sms-bridge.deliver).

items.description: The canonical Messaging message of every imported or already-imported legacy message (the legacy system's stable id mapping).

messaging.common.v1.MeetingMessageModera.description: Removal of a meeting-conversation message by the meeting authority (which already compared the host's role with the sender's). Idempotent.

messaging.common.v1.MemberRole.description: Â§30: OWNER (the owner), ADMIN, MODERATOR (moderates MEMBER / READ_ONLY / BOT_SERVICE members: remove, ban, unban; no role or ownership administration), MEMBER, READ_ONLY (reads its history window, sends no messages: READ_ONLY_MEMBER), BOT_SERVICE (BOT_OR_SERVICE principals only).

messaging.common.v1.MessageLifecycle.description: ACTIVE carries content; every other state is a tombstone without content. HIDDEN_FOR_YOU: deleted on the reader's own devices only.

moderatorPrincipalId.description: G6: the organization moderator (their principal in the organization's scope) an organization moderation request was relayed for; null for an application moderator credential.

messaging.common.v1.ModerationAction.description: Append-only; audited. No action reads PRIVATE_E2EE content.

messaging.common.v1.ReportDetail.description: A report with its evidence (moderation.manage; audited as REPORT_VIEWED).

messaging.common.v1.SecurityProfile.description: PRIVATE_E2EE: client-side MLS 1.0 encryption, the server holds no decryption key. MANAGED: server-processable, never presented as E2EE.

messaging.common.v1.SyncResult.description: applied=false: the update is stale or a replay (source version at or below the last applied one) and changed nothing.

messaging.common.v1.TeamChannelSnapshot.description: G7: an organization team's ACTIVE members (principals in the organization's scope).

ownerPrincipalId.description: Channel owner when this snapshot creates it.

title.description: Display title when this snapshot creates the channel.

sourceVersion.description: Monotonic snapshot version; at or below the applied one changes nothing.

platform.common.v1.RequestId.description: Server-generated identifier of one request / one service hop.

Operator.name: X-CF-Operator
Operator.description: The HQ staff member the admin bridge reads for (ADR 0068). Accepted only from cfmeet.admin-bridge; operator attribution from any other caller is refused on every internal route (403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: HQ's operation id (UUID). A repeated key for the same command and subject answers what the first call answered and applies nothing; the same key for anything else is 409 CONFLICT (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED). Missing: 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.

Approver.name: X-CF-Approver
Approver.description: The approving HQ staff member (a different person than X-CF-Operator). Required, with X-CF-Approval-Ref and X-CF-Intent-Digest, by every two-person (R3 / R4) command: without them 403 INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED (reason SECOND_PERSON_REQUIRED).

ApprovalRef.name: X-CF-Approval-Ref
ApprovalRef.description: HQ's reference of the single-use two-person approval (sent with X-CF-Approver).

IntentDigest.name: X-CF-Intent-Digest
IntentDigest.description: Hex SHA-256 of the approved intent (sent with X-CF-Approver).
